scope: one temporary-package, IR-off still-frame analysis on the unlocked Lumia 950 XL cityman

build.installation: separately signed temporary package; original probe package and its data were not replaced
build.result: aapt, javac, d8 and zipalign completed

camera.preview: opened; repeating capture results continued at the manual baseline

image_quality.roi_or_matcher_processing: skipped by the provisional low-signal gate; no frontal-face proposal

cleanup.cleanup_note: The post-test camera readback showed a client attributed to com.lumia.irisprobe; force-stopping the project probe cleared it.

interpretation: This confirms Camera2 can deliver a timestamp-matched YUV frame through the crop-aware path with the current full-frame crop. It does not exercise a nonzero crop, demonstrate useful iris texture, or validate matcher behavior. The UNKNOWN timestamp source prevents subtracting sensor timestamps from elapsed-realtime values.
limitations: The received image was near-black and rejected before ROI/matcher processing.
The test was IR-off and did not evaluate illumination or eye safety.
The camera was closed and the temporary package removed after the single still capture.
publication: local only; no commit, push, or PR
